findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_maison, get_product_detail, search_catalogue, list_collections · Private data: get_maison, get_product_detail, search_catalogue, list_collections · Public sink: get_maison, get_product_detail, list_collections.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_maison, get_product_detail, search_catalogue, list_collections · Private data: get_maison, get_product_detail, search_catalogue, list_collections · Public sink: get_maison, get_product_detail, list_collections

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
